detail_text: NSN 7R-2840-016578391-F7, REF NR 340-161-304-0, QTY 12 SE, DELIVERY FOB ORIGIN. The design of this part is unstable. Engineering, manufacturing, or performance characteristics indicate that the required design objectives have not been achieved. Major changes are contemplated because the part has a low process yield or has demonstrated marginal performance during tests or service use. These changes will render the present part obsolete and unusable in its present configuration. Limited acquisition/repair from the present source is anticipated pending configuration changes. 100% Small Business Set Aside applies to this procurement.
